name: StoryKingdom
summary:
Storykingdom is a hilarious, turn-based multiplayer party game where creativity meets competition. Players collaborate to build a narrative one phrase at a time, vying for the favor of a rotating Judge to score points. whether you are a group of friends, a classroom, or a Twitch community, storykingdom turns chaotic inputs into unforgettable legends.

Step into a world where the pen is mightier than the sword—and significantly funnier. In storykingdom, the narrative is in your hands, but the glory goes to the wittiest writer.

The game operates on a rotating role system. In each round, one player acts as the Chooser, while the others are Writers. The Writers must submit a phrase to continue the evolving story, attempting to match the tone, humor, or absurdity that the Chooser desires. The Chooser selects their favorite submission, awarding a point to the author and permanently cementing that phrase into the game's lore.
